narrative.data_gaps_md:
Core Banking System: The most significant data gap is the unknown core banking system (ISS-003). Proxy searches across vendor directories, job postings, conference presentations, and regulatory filings did not identify the core vendor. This gap affects (Automation), (Architecture), and creates cascading uncertainty across 4 categories. A Discovery session or direct stakeholder inquiry would resolve this gap and likely raise P3 and P4 scores by 0.3-0.5 points.
IAM/SSO Platform: No identity and access management or single sign-on platform was identified (E-059). This affects scoring and cybersecurity posture assessment. Internal documentation or Hubbl scan would clarify.
P3 Evidence Depth: P3 has the lowest evidence coverage (9 items vs P1's 29), resulting in higher reliance on absence signals and proxy evidence. An internal document review or Discovery engagement would substantially improve P3 confidence levels.
